Equality and unordered comparisons pass the negated tests. Consuming jumps denotes writing the u8-cast max_jumps value, not reading the current jump count.

The canonical implementation and active motion table support all six phase/domain combinations and delegated engine responsibilities. Both grounded collision callers literally compare against GA_Ground while the callee returns the stated conditional expression. The proposal appropriately preserves this unresolved interpretation and excludes compiled-layout claims. One-shot presentation is supported as self-retiring callback behavior, not a guarantee of once-per-move execution, consistent with functionality.md.

contradictions.reason: Accept the four .sdata2 fact deferrals and its relationship deferral: visible arithmetic does not establish section ownership, pool types or relocations. Accept the initialization/layout deferral: initialization reads max_jumps, while source union declarations do not prove compiled offsets or register allocation.

Accept superseding the finite-only threshold claim with proposal fact 0: the source uses negated less-than comparisons rather than ordinary greater-than-or-equal predicates, and the platform query mutates floor-skip state.

Accept all ground-loss, beyond-support and terrain-continuity deferrals, including mixed momentum/ground-query claims. The literal startup and travel guards do not justify silently reversing query polarity. Also accept deferral of detailed hit-state preservation from numeric flags and the claimed NULL callback interpretation; neither follows merely from the local transition arguments.

Accept naming deferrals for the aerial startup IASA alias, duplicate GroundToAir aliases, unqualified travel conversion alias and Lost_Enter analogies. Canonical callbacks and state registrations distinguish startup, invisible travel and visible ending. Rendered substitutions and comments do not recover original names or justify merging functions.

Accept all three exact explosion/Deku Nut asset deferrals. The source establishes a dedicated Vanish item and numeric presentation effects, not their exact visual or damaging interpretation. Item allocation can fail independently of subsequent wrapper effect/sound calls; the item has externally managed ownership and lifetime.

Accept unrestricted-surface and single-contact deferrals. The shared helper separately tests ceiling and both walls, invoking callbacks synchronously without an intervening return. Accept the domain-only conversion deferral: grounding additionally converts velocity, resets jump counters and checks support. Complete latch meanings and actual repeated-contact runtime occurrence remain deferred.

Accept every reduced/fractional-momentum deferral and the aerial-reappearance relationship deferral. The endings multiply snapshots by x54 without a proved range. Snapshots occur after motion and animation initialization, and repeated callbacks can repeat ending logic. This supports configured scaling, not guaranteed reduction or pristine pre-transition momentum.

Accept both exact-percentage and monotonic-command-phase deferrals. The zero-command branch computes y-y/10, not universally exact 90% retention. The command is tested on each invocation; no script timing or monotonic progression is established.

Accept unconditional helplessness, landing and neutral-return deferrals. FallSpecial has an x2224_b2 alternative, LandingFallSpecial has a hammer alternative, and the common action-ending dispatcher has exceptional paths. The source supports the calls and normal outcomes without proving those outcomes unconditional.
